title: Vitess: logical mysqldump backup per shard [SUPERSEDED by DEMO-169]
description: SUPERSEDED (2026-07-09, 0.O.1): `nexus backup take vitess` was rewritten to engine-native Vitess `file` BackupStorage (BackupShard + xtrabackup on NFS) — see DEMO-169-vitess-engine-native-backup. Retained only as a record of the pre-0.O.1 behavior. HISTORICAL: it ran a logical mysqldump of vt_commerce.customer from each shard PRIMARY socket (as vt_dba) -> a gzip archive node-local on each primary, because no Vitess BackupStorage was configured in 0.O.
whatProves: VitessAdapter.BackupTakeAsync runs mysqldump --single-transaction of vt_commerce.customer from each shard primary mysqld socket, validating the dump (CREATE TABLE marker) before sealing the gzip archive.
